$comment: The annotated layout boards. Each callout number on a review image is one row here; `component` is the id used in design/contract/component-states.json and docs/design/visual-interaction-contract.md. `source` names the audience view field the part is drawn from (wire protocol 1 at the base commit). Selectors are Frontend's own hooks unless marked PROPOSED.

phone-public.title: Phone · public layer · private sheet closed
phone-public.note: 360 x 760 CSS px, first screenful. Every phone shows this same layer whatever its role.

callouts.label: Header
callouts.source: Static. Wordmark and surface name.

callouts.label: Data-source banner
callouts.source: Client mode: fixture or emulator. Never shown for a live match.

callouts.label: Seat identity
callouts.source: audience.seatId. A seat number is public.

callouts.label: Phase caption
callouts.source: round, phase.kind, activeSeatId. Cue anchor: phase.

callouts.label: Countdown
callouts.source: phase.endsAt with server time. A local estimate; never a cue anchor.

callouts.label: Room vignette strip (PROPOSED)
callouts.source: The viewer's own seats[].location, a public fact, in the room's own colors. Decoration: hidden from assistive technology; the caption says the name.

callouts.label: Room name caption
callouts.source: The viewer's own seats[].location, as live text, with the room's icon.

callouts.label: Own public status
callouts.source: The viewer's own seats[] entry: health, jailed, captain; activeSeatId.

callouts.label: Also here
callouts.source: seats[] with the same location. Each piece is that seat's character and each tag its number and name: two PROPOSED public facts (DSN-REQ-6). Cue anchors: seat-N/place, seat-N/health.

callouts.label: Private dock (PROPOSED position)
callouts.source: None. Identical on every phone: no count, badge or highlight.

phone-public-full.title: Phone · public layer · whole page
phone-public-full.note: 360 CSS px wide, full length. The DOM list of all locations is the board on a phone.

callouts.label: All players by location
callouts.source: seats[] grouped by location. The complete tap and read path for the board.

callouts.label: Where you are
callouts.source: The viewer's own seats[].location. A paper keyline, not a color.

callouts.label: Captain marker
callouts.source: seats[].captain.

callouts.label: Display settings
callouts.source: Device preference and the player's own choice. Reduced motion, reduced effects and mute stay separate.

phone-private.title: Phone · private sheet open
phone-private.note: 360 x 760 CSS px. Everything inside the sheet is private to the seat. The phase caption and countdown stay in view above it.

callouts.label: Phase caption stays visible
callouts.source: As on the public layer. The open sheet stops below it.

callouts.label: Hide control
callouts.source: Local: the sheet is open on this device.

callouts.label: Role card (PROPOSED structure)
callouts.source: self.role. The player's own character with the role's device added; the device is in the role bundle every phone loads whole. Name no larger than the heading size.

callouts.label: Action card head
callouts.source: The card exists for every seat shown it. Icon and title never vary by role.

callouts.label: Resource pip (PROPOSED)
callouts.source: self.shotAvailable and ownPendingCommandIds, and nothing else. Not drawn while a command is unaccounted for.

callouts.label: Status word
callouts.source: The client's own command flow step. Cue anchor: registration.

callouts.label: Step line
callouts.source: Local choice plus approved copy. Focus rests here, never on a sending control.

callouts.label: Controls
callouts.source: Local. One primary control; at least 44 CSS px; a new control is inert for a moment.

phone-narrow-large-text.title: Phone · 320 px wide at 200% text
phone-narrow-large-text.note: The narrowest phone with the browser's default text size doubled (32 px). Chips wrap, cards stack, nothing is clipped and nothing shrinks to fit a frame.

phone-short-large-text.title: Phone · 320 x 568 at 200% text
phone-short-large-text.note: The shortest common phone with the browser's default text size doubled (32 px). The phase caption scrolls with the page instead of holding the top edge, and the dock is its control and nothing else, so the page keeps most of the screen.

player-wide.title: Player tablet · 768 px wide
player-wide.note: From 600 CSS px the same facts sit side by side. A wider screen grants no extra information.

frames.caption: Private sheet open beside the public layer

table-wide.title: Table display · 1280 x 720
table-wide.note: The shared screen. Public facts only: no private sheet, no command control, no role-dependent asset.

callouts.label: Phase caption
callouts.source: round, phase.kind, activeSeatId. Cue anchor: phase.

callouts.label: Countdown
callouts.source: phase.endsAt with server time.

callouts.label: Board page
callouts.source: One panel per location in seats[].location. Gutters are paper; no route is drawn.

callouts.label: Room panel with vignette
callouts.source: board-room-a, printed in Room A's color family. Caption is live text.

callouts.label: Playing pieces
callouts.source: seats[] in this location, each drawn as its player's character (PROPOSED fact). Identical for every role.

callouts.label: Marker badge on a piece
callouts.source: seats[].captain. Its word is in the roster and in the document.

callouts.label: Seat tag
callouts.source: The seat number and the player's name (PROPOSED fact), as live text.

callouts.label: Each room in its own colors
callouts.source: seats[].location = Jail. A room's color goes with its name and is never a team, a role or a state.

callouts.label: Roster
callouts.source: seats[] and activeSeatId, in words. Cue anchors: seat-N/place, seat-N/health.

table-varied.title: Table display · every public health state
table-varied.note: Healthy, Injured and Eliminated standing in Room A, with the active Captain among them. A character is not given a wound: its badges repeat what the roster says in words, and an eliminated seat's character loses its color.

table-narrow.title: Table display · 960 px wide
table-narrow.note: Below 1280 CSS px the roster sits under the board: its four columns do not fit beside a board still worth looking at.

table-crowd.title: Table display · nine in one room
table-crowd.note: The most a room ever holds. The pieces are smaller so that all nine stand side by side, and every second tag hangs a line lower. The other four rooms are empty and say so.

table-without-names.title: Before a seat has a name or a character
table-without-names.note: What the same design draws today, while no contract carries a name or a character (DSN-REQ-6): numbered tokens and “Player N”. The five rooms and their colors need nothing new.

reconnect.title: Connection lost · last known state
reconnect.note: The view is kept and marked stale by words, a taped banner and a hatched frame. Actions are paused; nothing is greyed out.

missing-assets.title: Without art
missing-assets.note: What every device shows until its art has arrived, and for good if it never does: disc tokens with live numerals, names and chips with their words, plain panels on each room's own ground color. Nothing is hidden waiting for a picture.
